videos.description:
Lead First-Ever Serverless Espresso in India | AWS Community Day Ahmedabad

What happens when cloud, community, and coffee come together? ☕

In this video, I share my experience leading the first-ever Serverless Espresso in India at AWS Community Day Ahmedabad as part of the AWS Community Builder Fair.

Serverless Espresso is a fun and interactive way to demonstrate the power of AWS Serverless services through a real-world coffee ordering experience powered by AWS Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, EventBridge, and more.

This event brought together AWS Community Builders, cloud enthusiasts, developers, architects, and students to learn, network, and celebrate the AWS community.

videos.title: AWS Cloud Club Community Program For Students - AWS Cloud Club Captain
videos.description:
AWS Cloud Clubs is recently announced a new community program, especially for students by AWS.

It's a wonderful opportunity for students who believe in Community,

AWS Cloud Clubs are peer-to-peer user groups for students, by students. Cloud Clubs allow you to network, attend career-building events, host hackathons, and more.

Even you can earn perks such as AWS credits, certification vouchers, swag, learning and networking experiences, and more.

Learn more about AWS Cloud Clubs & Apply as AWS Cloud Club Captain here: https://aws.amazon.com/developer/community/students/

Don't forget to share this with the maximum students community around the globe, tag your current / pass out college in comments for supporting & spreading the word across more Colleges / Universities / Students around the globe 🌎, Appreciated your support, Thank you All🙏

videos.title: AWS Community Builder Journey | Featured by AWS | Part 3
videos.description:
My AWS Community Builder Journey Featured by AWS Part 3

Staying close to my family and community has always been an important part of my journey.

Living in Gujarat, India, while working remotely has allowed me to build a global career without losing touch with the people and values that matter most. Family, culture, and community continue to shape how I work, learn, build, and give back.

The greatest reward isn't recognition it's knowing that something I shared helped another developer or student take their first step into Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Cloud Computing.

I'm grateful to AWS for featuring my story in the Pass the Mic: AWS Community Stories series, and thankful to everyone who has supported me throughout this journey.

videos.title: AWS Community Builder Journey | Featured by AWS | Part 2
videos.description:
My AWS Community Builder Journey | Featured by AWS | Part 2

My journey started in a small village, but my career has connected me with developers around the world.

Working remotely as a Serverless Engineer has shown me that you don't have to live in a big city to build a global career. With the right mindset, continuous learning, and hands-on experience, opportunities can come from anywhere.

Every day brings new challenges from designing AWS Serverless solutions and building Cloud Computing applications to debugging production systems and learning new AWS services. Each challenge has helped me grow as both an engineer and a community contributor.

Whether I'm building cloud solutions or spending time with my family, the same mindset guides me: stay curious, keep learning, keep building, and enjoy the journey.

This is Part 2 of my AWS Community Builder journey, proudly featured in the Pass the Mic: AWS Community Stories series.

videos.title: AWS Community Builder Journey | Featured by AWS | Part 1
videos.description:
My AWS Community Builder Journey | Featured by AWS | Part 1

Teaching others has always been one of the best ways for me to learn.

In this first part of my journey, I share how everything started from attending my very first AWS User Group meetups to becoming part of the inaugural AWS Community Builder program.

What began as curiosity about Amazon Web Services (AWS) soon became a passion for Cloud Computing, Serverless, learning, building, and sharing knowledge with the community. Creating content and helping beginners take their first steps into AWS has been one of the most rewarding parts of my journey.

I'm honored that AWS featured my story in the Pass the Mic: AWS Community Stories series.

If you're just starting your AWS journey, remember: every expert was once a beginner.
